notes.title: New demo is now available
notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce the release of my revamped demo! Thanks to your invaluable feedback, I've made significant strides in enhancing the game.

🎮 What's New? 🎮
🖼️ Graphical Marvels: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals that breathe life into the game world.
🐞 Bug Be Gone: I've exterminated those pesky bugs that challenged your playthroughs.
🤩 Extended Experience: This demo is now longer, offering a more in-depth look at the game's captivating storyline.

🧐 Your Feedback Matters 🧐
But I'm not done yet! Your feedback continues to be the driving force behind my improvements. Help me refine the game further by sharing your thoughts.

📜 Unveiling the Story 📜
Get a glimpse into the heart of the narrative. Discover what the story is truly about as I peel back the layers, revealing its depth and intrigue.

🚀 Dive into the enhanced world of my game and be part of the journey. Download the new demo today and let me know what you think! Your adventure awaits.
